name: Electro-Harmonix Big Muff Pi (V1 'triangle', 67#1 standard variant, c. 1971)
description: Electro-Harmonix Big Muff Pi, Version 1 'triangle' as traced by Kit Rae (variant 'V1 67#1', the 'standard' triangle circuit he estimates at 60-70 % of all triangle units, c. 1971, 1967 pot dates, FS36999 silicon NPNs, 1N914-class diodes, all linear pots). EH PCB numbering, so Q4 is the input stage and Q1 the output stage. Input: R2 33 kΩ, C1 0.1 µF into the Q4 shunt-feedback common-emitter booster (R14 100 kΩ base to ground, R9 470 kΩ ∥ C10 500 pF collector to base, R13 10 kΩ, R22 100 Ω). C4 0.1 µF into the 100 kΩ Sustain pot with R23 820 Ω at its foot. Two identical clipping stages Q3 and Q2 (C5/C13 0.1 µF, R19/R12 8.2 kΩ, R20/R16 100 kΩ, R17/R15 470 kΩ ∥ C12/C11 500 pF, C6/C7 0.1 µF in series with an antiparallel 1N914 pair from base to collector, R18 10 kΩ and R11 15 kΩ collectors, R21/R10 100 Ω emitters). Passive tone stack: low-pass R8 33 kΩ / C8 10 nF and high-pass C9 4 nF / R5 33 kΩ mixed by the 100 kΩ Tone pot. Q1 output stage (C3 0.1 µF, R7 390 kΩ / R3 100 kΩ divider bias, R6 12 kΩ, R4 2.7 kΩ), C2 0.1 µF into the 100 kΩ Volume pot. 9 V battery, effect-on (true-bypass) state.

sources.title: Kit Rae, The Big Muff π Page, 'Big Muff Pi Versions and Schematics, Part 1 (1969-1974)': V1 'standard' triangle variant description (most common V1 circuit, R5/R8 33k) and schematic 'Version 1 BIG MUFF - V1 67#1' (circuit traced by Kit Rae; every value in this file). Archived copy used

ElectroSmash, 'Big Muff Pi Analysis' (stage topology and operation, 1N914 clipping, bias chart of the 1977 V3 red/black for comparison: clipping-stage collectors 4.4 V, bases 0.7 V, emitters 0.07 V). Archived copy used
Fairchild/ON 2N5088 SPICE model (library 2N5088: IS 5.911 fA, BF 1122, BR 1.271) used as the basis of the FS36999 stand-in

FS36999.note: unverified: FS36999 is a Fairchild house number with no published SPICE card. IS and BR from the 2N5088 card (ElectroSmash lists 2N5088/BC239/BC549C as equivalents); BF 250 is an assumed mid-range vintage hFE

controls.label: Volume
controls.note: 100 kΩ linear pot after C2; wiper is the output

controls.label: Sustain
controls.note: 100 kΩ linear pot between C4 and R23 820 Ω; wiper feeds the first clipping stage

controls.label: Tone
controls.note: 100 kΩ linear pot mixing the 33k/10n low-pass (counter-clockwise, bass) and the 4n/33k high-pass (clockwise, treble); mid scoop at the centre

controls.label: Lamp
controls.note: Legacy indicator lamp parameter. The V1 triangle has no LED; no circuit meaning, stored for preset round-trip

controls.label: Bass
controls.note: Legacy 'Bass' parameter. The Big Muff has only Volume, Sustain and Tone; no circuit meaning, stored only

controls.label: Treble
controls.note: Legacy 'Treble' parameter (id R). No such knob on the pedal; no circuit meaning, stored only

parts.note: unverified: Kit Rae's trace says '10k or 15k' for this variant; 10k chosen
unverified: original diodes marked SYL GY920 (type unknown); Kit Rae: measure 0.5-0.6 V, 1N914/1N4148 equivalent
Kit Rae: 15k (12k also used but rare)
